brief: Thrifty farm-made machine shed built around a retired wooden railroad boxcar: the white-painted plank boxcar body (about 9 ft by 36 ft, with its iron strap hardware and a boarded end door) sits on the ground as a lockable tool room, and a shallow shed roof of corrugated metal extends off one long side on a row of round wooden posts to make an open implement bay about 16 ft deep, its fascia patched with vertical metal panels. Tall grass, a volunteer shrub growing in the bay, white outbuildings behind.
